description: This file defines an abstract class 'PrimaryOperationFailed' that models connection issues related to primary storage communication failures in Orleans Event Sourcing. It includes logic for computing retry delays with exponential backoff and randomization.

classes.name: PrimaryOperationFailed
classes.description: An abstract class representing a connection failure when communicating with primary storage, including retry delay logic.

methods.name: ComputeRetryDelay
methods.description: Calculates the delay before the next retry attempt, using exponential backoff with randomization based on previous delay.
